meta.source_note: SAMPLE DATA – not real advice. Doses/PHI from the product label. All PHI (days), REI (hours) and doses (product unit per στρέμμα, 1 στρ = 0.1 ha) are ILLUSTRATIVE – check the label and the Greek registration database. phi_days null = not applicable (fertiliser, or pre-emergence herbicide whose timing covers PHI). Products are generic labels, no brands. Weather: observed 9-15 Nov from nearest station, forecast 16-22 Nov from model blend, both elevation-corrected; leaf-wet hours are estimates (no sensor). est_crates = area × yield assumption ÷ crate kg, ~10% waste; supply spread evenly over harvest window. Leek has no orders yet (harvest Jan 2027).

alerts.title: Frost at leaf level on the low plain, night Wed 18 → Thu 19 Nov
alerts.body: Clear, calm nights Tue-Thu. Cold air drains off Geraneia and pools on the plain: 2 m air min 0.5 °C at Μεσαίο Χωράφι, 0.0 °C at Κάτω Κάμπος, 0.2 °C at Νότιος Κάμπος. Leaf surfaces can be 2-3 °C colder than the air. Young coriander and dill (Μεσαίο Χωράφι) are the most exposed. Geraneia Slope is warmer (4.0 °C, above the cold layer) and Pachi (5.0 °C, sea).
alerts.action: Wed 18 Nov before sunset: cover coriander + dill (Μεσαίο Χωράφι) with 17-19 g/m² fleece (gains ~1-2 °C). Remove Thu 19 after ~10:00 when thawed, before the windy front on Fri. Thu 19: no harvest of spinach (Κάτω Κάμπος) or chicory before leaves thaw (~10:00).

why.rule: Warn when forecast 2 m min <= 2 °C AND night wind <= 5 km/h AND clear sky on parcels below 50 m. Leaf surface can be 2-3 °C below air on such nights. Damage temperature for each crop is NOT set by the app – your agronomist can set it.
why.source: Forecast: model blend (ECMWF/ICON, ~2-9 km grid), corrected to parcel elevation/exposure; leaf-wet hours ESTIMATED from RH>=90%; cold-pooling pattern = rule (no frost sensor on parcels)
why.confidence: Medium (that it gets near 0 °C on the low plain); Low (whether leaves are damaged)

alerts.title: Spinach downy mildew risk HIGH – Pachi Coast
alerts.body: Leaves estimated wet 13-15 h every night since the rain of Thu 12-Fri 13 Nov, nights 6.0-9.0 °C, and the front on Fri 20-Sun 22 Nov brings 27.5 mm. Pachi had downy mildew in Dec 2025. This spinach is 67% grown, harvest from Thu 3 Dec – there is time for one protective spray that clears its PHI before harvest.
alerts.action: See recommendation R01: one protective spray Wed 18 Nov (mandipropamid, FRAC 40). Before spraying, check lower-leaf undersides for grey-violet fuzzy growth (sporulation); yellow patches alone are not proof.

why.rule: High when leaf wetness >= 10 h on >= 3 of the last 5 nights with night temp 5-15 °C, AND rain forecast within 5 days, AND parcel has mildew history.

alerts.title: Spinach Κάτω Κάμπος: mildew conditions, but it is in harvest – do NOT spray
alerts.body: Same wet nights after the rain (leaf-wet 11-13 h per night). This lot is being cut now (safe since Mon 9 Nov). Any fungicide now would lock harvest for 7-14 days and break supply.
alerts.action: Keep cutting (~15 crates/day) Tue 17-Fri 20 Nov and Mon 23-Sat 28 Nov; not Thu before ~10:00 thaw, not in the rain Fri pm-Sun. Scout lower-leaf undersides each cut; grade out leaves with grey-violet growth.

why.rule: If a planting is harvesting AND a spray's PHI would block cuts before the end of its harvest window, the app does not recommend a spray; it recommends faster harvest + scouting.

recommendations.action: Spray mandipropamid 25% SC (FRAC 40), 0.06 L/στρ in 50 L water/στρ, on the 1.5 στρ spinach only. why.rule: Spray only if: leaves dry (after dew ~10:00), gust < 20 km/h, no rain for >= 24 h after (product needs ~1 h to dry), planting not harvesting, new PHI ends before harvest starts, FRAC group different from the last spray on this lot, product registered for crop and in stock and not expired.

recommendations.action: Fertigate leek with calcium nitrate (nitrate N) 5 kg/στρ via drip = ~0.8 kg N/στρ. Do NOT top-dress urea on the surface. Do NOT give N to spinach (PL01, PL08), rocket (PL04, PL13) or other lots < 21 days from harvest.
recommendations.window: Mon 23 - Wed 25 Nov (after the front, when drip restarts)

why.rule: N form must suit soil: on pH >= 7.5 with free lime, surface urea/ammonium loses NH3 unless incorporated by >= 10 mm rain or irrigation → use nitrate via fertigation. Not before heavy rain (leaching). Leafy greens: last N >= 21 days before harvest – winter low light raises leaf nitrate; EU sets maximum nitrate levels for spinach and rocket (Reg. (EU) 2023/915).
